entries.clue: Mark left in the flowerbed mud, telling a keen eye height, weight and haste
Briar the detective fills when a case needs three quiet hours
Of the long queenly age of Empire, top hats and the penny post
Yellow-grey murk that swallows a whole street and every witness in it
Sugar beaten with a drop of water, spread over a fairy cake
White, sticky and clamped overnight, it makes two offcuts one
Kneaded soft in the hand, then pressed round a pane to bed the glass in
Old cloth thrown over the furniture before the decorating begins
Apple parcel sealed corner to corner and baked until golden
Stradivarius bought for 55 shillings, scraped at whenever a case sticks
Lemon's grated yellow in a cake mix, or great enthusiasm
Bladed block skimmed along a board to curl off fine shavings
Squeezing frosting through a nozzle to make rosettes and swirls
